items.title: LIVE UPDATES: First BARMM parliamentary elections
items.description: Bookmark and refresh this page for the latest news, photos, videos, and analyses as Rappler closely follows the historic elections

items.title: Murad’s son beats ex-MILF commander for SGA 1st District seat in BARMM polls
items.description: The United Bangsamoro Justice Party’s Mansor Ebrahim is the son of Moro Islamic Liberation Front chairman Murad, who leads the central committee that axed the Bangsamoro Federalist Party’s Butch Malang as MILF commander

items.title: Defense questions ex-Sandigan presiding justice as witness
items.description: The defense panel has questioned the decision of the prosecution to present retired Sandiganbayan presiding justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang as the Senate impeachment court tackles the article on the alleged unexplained wealth of Vice President Sara Duterte.

items.title: 64% say district reps ‘doing a good job’ – OCTA
items.description: About six in every 10 Filipinos believe that their district representatives are doing a good job, indicating what the OCTA Research group described as a stark difference between views at the local and institutional levels.

items.title: Economy ‘more than steady’ – Marcos
items.description: Despite inflation concerns and the weakening of the peso, President Marcos described the Philippines as “more than steady.”

items.title: Manibela hits ‘deals’ to delay strike
items.description: Some transport leaders were offered “personal deals” to discourage them from joining the strike, transport group Manibela said yesterday.

items.title: 2 areas in BARMM placed under Comelec control
items.description: Two areas in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao were placed under the control of the Commission on Elections following reports of violent incidents and compromised ballots during the region’s first parliamentary elections.

items.title: BIR scraps VAT on system loss charge
items.description: The Bureau of Internal Revenue has formally removed the value-added tax on the allowable system loss charge in electricity bills, a move seen to lower the amount passed on to consumers.

items.title: FLP to honor law scholars, MBA fellows, dissertation writing winners
items.description: The Foundation for Liberty & Prosperity will celebrate the newest recipients of its academic awards on Sept. 16 at the Manila Polo Club, with First Lady Liza Marcos as special guest and Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Eli Remolona Jr. as guest speaker.

items.title: Ex-justice: VP may be removed for hiding assets
items.description: Impeachable officials like Vice President Sara Duterte may be removed from office for “intentional concealment” of assets including those owned by their spouses, according to retired Sandiganbayan presiding justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang.

items.title: Senate OKs 5-year barangay, SK term bill
items.description: The Senate yesterday passed on third and final reading a bill seeking to fix the terms of barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan officials at five years, effectively postponing the upcoming Nov. 2 barangay and SK elections.

items.title: Marcos on Sara tirades: You can’t force anyone to love you
items.description: Not even the most powerful man in the land can demand affection.

items.title: Ex-SK chair leads race in Lanao del Sur 7th District
items.description: Rayyan Mindalano has an insurmountable lead over his closest rival, former Bacolod-Kalawi mayor Nora Dipatuan

items.title: Ex-Ganassi mayor set to take Lanao del Sur’s 6th District BARMM seat
items.description: Hosni Macapodi wins against United Bangsamoro Justice Party-backed Jamael Balt

items.title: BARMM MP Rashdi Adiong tops Lanao del Sur’s 9th District polls
items.description: MP Rashdi Adiong is on the verge of securing a seat of power for the Adiong-led SIAP in the Bangsamoro Parliament

items.title: Martin Romualdez now in Payatas jail a week after arrest
items.description: (1st UPDATE) The Sandiganbayan 3rd Division ordered Romualdez's transfer of custody from PGH to Payatas after PGH doctors found that he is in stable condition and no longer in need of hospital confinement

items.title: Unopposed Lanao del Sur 8th District bet takes BARMM seat
items.description: Ahmad 'Arrie' Balindong will continue his stay as a member of parliament in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao

items.title: Pre-shaded ballots, vote buying, violence in first BARMM elections | The wRap
items.description: Today’s headlines: BARMM elections, Martin Romualdez, Chiz Escudero

items.title: Asum clan patriarch on verge of winning Lanao del Sur’s 5th District BARMM seat
items.description: Arimao Asum, patriarch of the Asum political dynasty in Lumbayanague, Lanao del Sur, leads the race for the province's 5th District seat in the first elections of the Bangsamoro Parliament

items.title: Lanao del Sur governor’s nephew leads race for 3rd District BARMM seat
items.description: Serbisyong Inklusibo-Alyansang Progresibo Party bet Abdul Rauf Adiong wins against two former members of the Bangsamoro Parliament and a former village chief
